scope: The Minaret of Jam as documented in October 2006, including its octagonal brick base, tapering shafts, geometric bands, turquoise tile register, surviving balcony supports and crown. Nearby walls, footbridges, archaeological remains and river surface are outside the asset.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: UNESCO records a 65 m tower, 9 m diameter octagonal base, multiple tapering shafts, fired-brick relief and turquoise inscription.
The survey-based study reports a 3.4 degree north-northeast lean. The exterior reproduces this approximately.

next: Build and review the tapered shaft, north-northeast lean, masonry bands, surviving balcony supports and octagonal base on the original field.
